C O N T A C T
C A R R E R  O B J E C T I V E
Seeking challenging opportunity with an organization where I can utilize
my technical skills. I want to contribute to the organization with hard
work,sincerity, patience and dedication.
6388703566
vishalsonkar120130@gmail.com
K-12/48 World
bank,Barra,Kanpur
nagar,208027,U.P.
E D U C A T I O N
W O R K  E X P E R I E N C E
	Summer Training of 4weeksatRSPL

	LOhum cleantech Pvt. Ltd. ,Greater Noida, Uttar pradesh(20dec
2023 to 05aug 2024) as a production opreator.


	High School Passed from U.P. board
Allahabadin 2018 with 87%


	Intermediate Passed from U.P.
board 2020 with 76%


	Leaching reactor is raw material charge & reaction time maintain
thencheck PH & separate the elements (Ni, MN, Co, Pb, Fe, etc.)

	Maintain records of BMR & equipment’scalibration.


	Diploma in Chemical Engeneering
passed in 2023 with 70%


	Handles odhazards chemicals in accordance with their safety.

	Developed & Maintains the SOPs of chemicals process.


	Malco Energy Ltd. South Goa (11Nov 2024 to till now) Process
associate.

	Handle with sodium Plant RMWP(Raw Material Washing Plant)
Leaching Plant.


H O B B I E S
	Handling Manpower and Process.


	Reading books

	Cricket

	Travelling


K N O W L E D G E  O F  E Q U I P M E N T
	Pumps(Centrifugal,Reciprocating,ADDD,Gear,VacuumPump)

	Dryer(TrayDryer,ANFDryer)

	HeatExchanger,pHmeter,Hydrometer,Filter press


C O M P U T E R  S K I L L
	Valve(Ball,Gate,Butterfly,Control)

	Mannual Euopratur, UBF


	Basic knowledge of computer.


P E R S O N A L  Q U A L I T I E S
L A N G U A G E S
	Enthusiastic,confidentand energetic with our work.

	I have asterling character of high integrity and honesty.

	Future orientedand effective hardwork with ability to learn.


	English: Intermediate

	Hindi: fluent


	Friendly,creative and sincere.

	I am a quick learner.




D E C L A R A T I O N
I Declare that to the information given in these curriculumvitae are true
to the best of my knowledge.
D A T E :
P L A C E :
( V I S H A L  S O N K A R )
